segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Kael pushes open the heavy oak door of The Rusty Anchor, stepping out of the biting mountain wind and into a reek of stale ale and soot.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The tavern is deathly quiet for an evening, illuminated only by a few guttering tallow candles casting long, dancing shadows across the splintered floorboards.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Two scrawny goblins crouch atop an overturned table near the hearth, tearing into a loaf of dark bread while their yellow eyes lock onto the armored veteran.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The creature on the left bares its jagged teeth, reaching slowly for a crude shortsword resting on the bench.

suggestions.text: Draw your longsword and charge the goblin scout
Keep your hand on your hilt and demand they step away from the hearth
Slowly back toward the exit to assess the room
